verdict.rationale: Auth0 docs mention bulk import/export of user data (e.g., 'Migrate your user data into and out of Auth0 with automatic migration and bulk imports and exports') and log streaming export, but there is no explicit documentation of exporting all account/user data in an open, portable format, nor a documented account-closure/data-portability workflow. Community commentary explicitly flags 'strong vendor lock-in' as a downside, which cuts against the 'leave freely' framing though it is not a concrete technical failure. missing for 10: explicit open-format (e.g., JSON/CSV) full-account export spec, GDPR/data-portability documentation, and independent confirmation of a working exit/export flow.
